scope: Planning scenarios using clean 13-node local engine/coordinator execution and actual frozen-result autonomous relay execution; not measured whole-game or complete relay spending

measuredSearch.initialPosition: Standard starting FEN and complete e2e4 history, actual coordinator plus full Stockfish
measuredSearch.includes: warm full-budget engine updates; reserved-cycle increase was zero
measuredSearch.excludes: cold reservation, separately measured coordinator and additional relay costs

coordinatorAndMoveSignature.includes: verified RH requests, progress calls, one threshold move signature and active-readiness refresh

autonomousRelay.includes: second threshold signature, polling and scoped fault/receipt recovery; frozen genuine model result

creationOnly.excludes: chunk upload, installation, freezing/operating reserves, ledger fees

notes: Search debit is position-dependent; a fixed node budget does not fix its instruction count.
ICP local wall time is not a public-network latency guarantee.
Runtime memory exceeds the Wasm file size; operating reserves and storage must be funded.
Whole-game costs also include position/retry variation, installation, storage, idle hosting and RH transactions; these scenarios are not a measured complete game.
Initial caps follow the recorded user approval; receipts establish amounts allocated. Larger twenty-game caps remain unapproved.
The public page remains unconfigured and paid entry closed.
